description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts. Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship, and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies, ethical guidelines, and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement, and recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.

Core Competencies

  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required

description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior para atuar em um ecossistema de aplicativos digitais iOS e Android, com múltiplos produtos, marcas e integrações, garantindo qualidade técnica, performance e experiência consistente para o usuário final.

Você precisa ser uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia, com forte perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo, capaz de atuar em arquitetura, sustentação e evolução de apps em produção em um ambiente ágil.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicativos móveis em Flutter (Dart) para Android e iOS, desde a concepção até a publicação e manutenção, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
  • Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
  • Integrar os apps com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo autenticação, tratamento robusto de erros e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
  • Atuar na sustentação dos aplicativos: correção de bugs, investigação com logs e Crashlytics, análise de performance e prevenção de regressões.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de widgets), garantindo cobertura mínima em fluxos críticos de negócio e UI.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), contribuindo para decisões técnicas e de produto.
  • Colaborar com times de back-end, produto e design na definição de contratos de API, integrações, Design System e experiências consistentes entre plataformas.
  • Apoiar e evoluir a observabilidade dos apps (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config) e a experimentação via testes A/B.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e, quando necessário, participação em etapas técnicas de seleção (entrevistas e avaliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência sólida com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo publicação e manutenção de apps em Android e iOS.
  • Forte domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura em camadas, Clean separação de responsabilidades e gerenciamento de estado com GetX (lifecycle, .obs, Obx, GetBuilder).
  • Vivência com testes unitários e testes de widgets em Flutter, aplicados a lógica de negócio e componentes de UI.
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.
  • Conhecimento de Git (Bitbucket ou equivalentes), fluxos de pull request e práticas de code review.
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com múltiplas marcas / white-label apps, mantendo configurações distintas em um ecossistema compartilhado de packages.
  • Vivência com packages interconectados, modularização e gestão de dependências locais (path-based dependencies) e overrides.
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

Informações adicionais

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

Além de trabalhar no maior grupo de moda do Brasil, focado em impulsionar talentos e especializado em fazer gigante, por aqui você também ganha:

Vale Refeição ou Refeitório;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (apólice coletiva opcional);

Gympass;

Day-off no seu aniversário para você curtir muito;

Até 50% de desconto nas nossas marcas;

Código de Vendedor, com direito a comissão sobre vendas nos sites;

PLR, de acordo com a nossa política;

Vagas de estacionamento e van no fim do dia, para te levar até o metrô mais próximo;

Cursos, palestras e Trilhas de Desenvolvimento, ao vivo e na nossa plataforma de conteúdo;

Avaliação de desempenho;

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.

    Profissional que identifica, alerta, diagnostica e resolve falhas no sistema de banco de dados ou na infraestrutura digital. Também faz alterações no design do banco de dados.

  4. Despachante aduaneiro

    É o intermediário no Comércio Exterior que pode representar o importador, exportador ou outra função relacionada ao despacho de mercadorias. É necessário possuir ficha limpa junto às autoridades policiais, ser brasileiro(a), ter mais de 18 anos e possuir pelo menos o Ensino Médio completo. Embora não exista um curso específico para se tornar um despachante aduaneiro, é recomendado buscar uma graduação em comércio exterior, logística, administração ou direito.

  5. Diretor de Logística

    Promove, planeja e controla fluxo e armazenamento de insumos e matérias-primas de uma empresa e garante recursos para execução de todas suas atividades. Entre os requisitos estão raciocínio lógico, visão estratégica e sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação interpessoal, desenvolvimento proativo e senso crítico. Ser graduado e especializado na área, com pós-graduação ou MBA e proficiência em outro idioma, principalmente inglês são requisitos obrigatórios.

  6. Operador logístico

    Responsável pela operação, tem a função de entrada para o segmento logístico. Apesar de valorizar questões comportamentais, como organização, senso de responsabilidade e proatividade, muitas empresas não exigem experiência anterior, o que pode ser uma grande oportunidade para primeiro emprego.

  7. Especialista em SEO

    Responsável pela estratégia, gerenciamento e execução de atividades de marketing, com o objetivo de ranquear bem um site na busca orgânica do Google, para determinadas palavras-chave. Deve ter expertise em Google Analytics, publicidade paga e familiaridade com ferramentas de pesquisa e gerenciamento de palavras-chave.

  8. Gerente de Inteligência de Mercado

    Gerencia e estrutura a coleta de dados sobre a concorrência, tendências de consumo, comportamento do público e cenários do mercado, visando a definição de políticas e processos e apoia os departamentos de marketing, comunicação e vendas. Desejável ter conhecimento sobre mercado nacional e internacional, importação e exportação, além de Ensino Superior em economia, administração, marketing, estatística ou áreas relacionadas.

  9. Engenheiro Civil

    Profissional que planeja, projeta, executa e faz a gestão de obras de infraestrutura e empreendimento. É necessário ter graduação em engenharia civil e conhecimento em ferramentas técnicas como Excel, AutoCAD e SketchUp.

  10. Profissional ESG

    A profissional ressalta que a área de ESG tem crescido como um todo, por isso os cargos variam desde auxiliares, gestores a heads e diretores. Supervisionam estratégias e práticas ambientais, sociais e de governança, promovendo sustentabilidade, equidade e conformidade nas operações corporativas. É importante que o profissional tenha Ensino Superior completo e cursos ambientais. Outras características são: visão sistêmica, inteligência emocional, inovação e foco na diversidade.

title: Assistant Registrar, Records & Registration
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students.

This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including, but not limited to, registration permissions, overrides, waitlist and batch registration.
  • Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
  • Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
  • Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
  • Produces academic standing and Deans list reports for review by the Provost’s Office and various schools and colleges.
  • Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
  • Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
  • Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
  • Develops and delivers point-of-use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
  • Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account

Core Competencies

  • Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e. Banner, Colleague, Workday).
  • Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
  • Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
  • Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
  • Detail-oriented and customer service and compliance-focused.
  • Proven record of accountability and follow-through.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar’s office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026. Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

  • Espírio colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;

  • Inglês.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
  • Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
  • Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
  • Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
  • Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
  • Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
  • Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
  • Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
  • When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
  • Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
  • Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
  • Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
  • Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
  • Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
  • Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
  • Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
  • Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
  • Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
  • Carry out national and international trips, as needed
  • Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
  • Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
  • In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
  • Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
  • Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders

Required

  • Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
  • Active CREA registration
  • Desirable post-graduation in a related area
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD®, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
  • Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
  • Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
  • Good vision and business understanding
  • Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
  • Expertise in installation analysis
  • Experience using OrcaFlex software
  • Experience in developing tenders, including methodologies, schedules, and financial estimates/calculations
  • Experience in team leadership and team member guidance

description:
Overview

Somos um Grupo formado por marcas com mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, Paraná e Ceará, realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade valoriza profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos. Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesqueléticas e de terapia assistida. Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história; para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores.

Nossos valores

Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! Venha fazer história com a gente!

title: Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst
description:
InPlanet is a mission‑driven, remote‑first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO₂ while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil – where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care of Accounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You'll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically – structured, purpose‑driven, and comfortable switching between hands‑on tasks and higher‑level discussions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month‑end and year‑end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash‑flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3‑5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards, IFRS, and multi‑entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR), and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities

Key Qualities

  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard‑working and hands‑on
  • Detail‑oriented and analytical, with a problem‑solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross‑border or fast‑growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil‑based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

  1. Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  3. Optional third interview
  4. Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  5. Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  6. Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

description:
Do you want to impact our clients with your vision and experience? Do you believe in the power of doing more for clients? This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from one of our offices in Latin America (Brazil, Chile and Colombia). Please submit all application materials, including your résumé, in English. Aon is in the business of better decisions . At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How This Opportunity Is Different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation, specifically compensation data and/or benchmarking.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How We Support Our Colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The West Campus Facilities Manager provides senior-level leadership and operational management for all facilities, maintenance, custodial coordination, and infrastructure operations across Howard University’s West Campus. This position serves as the primary facilities authority for the campus, ensuring that buildings, utilities, and grounds remain safe, reliable, and fully operational. The Manager oversees maintenance teams, custodial partners, and contractors while ensuring full compliance with engineering standards, APPA benchmarks, regulatory requirements, and University service expectations. The role carries significant operational responsibility and autonomy due to the size, complexity, and visibility of West Campus.

Supervisory Authority

Supervises maintenance technicians, trades personnel, custodial leads, administrative support, and contracted service providers assigned to West Campus. Oversees external vendors performing preventive maintenance, building repairs, custodial operations, inspections, and other facilities-related services.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, students, Residence Life, Public Safety, academic departments, and administrative units. External contacts include contractors, vendors, utility partners, regulatory inspectors, custodial firms, and maintenance service providers. The Manager serves as the face of PFM for all West Campus facilities matters.

Principal Accountabilities

Campus Operations & Building Systems Oversight

  • Leads daily facilities operations for West Campus to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality building performance.
  • Manages preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance across HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life-safety systems.
  • Conducts regular facility inspections to identify deficiencies, risks, code issues, and asset renewal needs.
  • Ensures timely work order management, documentation accuracy, and performance tracking through the CMMS.
  • Ensures coordination with capital projects and handoff from construction to operations.

Custodial Management & Service Quality

  • Coordinates custodial scheduling, assignments, and service quality aligned with APPA Level 2 standards.
  • Evaluates custodial contractor performance and directs corrective actions when service gaps arise.

Vendor, Contract, and Compliance Oversight

  • Oversees on-site performance of vendors supporting maintenance, custodial, utilities, and technical service operations.
  • Ensures full compliance with OSHA, EPA, NFPA, fire/life safety codes, and environmental health requirements.
  • Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory documentation.

Asset Management & Preventive Maintenance

  • Implements preventive maintenance programs to optimize asset life, system reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Works closely with the Deputy Director and QA/QC Manager on engineering standards and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Recommends capital renewal and lifecycle replacement priorities for campus infrastructure.

Stakeholder Relations & Customer Service

  • Acts as the primary point of contact for West Campus stakeholders.
  • Communicates maintenance activities, project impacts, and operational issues clearly and professionally.
  • Supports high-demand operational needs such as special events, move-ins/outs, and seasonal transitions.

Emergency Response & Safety Leadership

  • Leads operational response during outages, building emergencies, and severe weather events.
  • Ensures appropriate use of PPE, safe work practices, and hazard mitigation strategies.
  • Supports continuity-of-operations planning for critical campus systems.

Other Duties

  • Provides input on staffing needs, training, workflows, and operational efficiencies.
  • Supports deferred maintenance efforts and campus improvement initiatives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Expert knowledge of building operations, maintenance, and custodial service standards.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Solid problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred; associate degree with extensive experience considered. At least 7 years of progressive experience in facilities operations, building maintenance, or engineering services. Supervisory experience overseeing teams or contractors. Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and building systems. Proficiency with CMMS systems and work order management. OSHA, CEFP, or trade certifications preferred. Ability to respond to emergencies, work evenings/weekends, and support critical campus needs.

Overview

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

Lead Life Cycle Engineer is Responsible for service provisioning and the end-to-end lifecycle of network security, shared infrastructure, SD-WAN, and other cloud security solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of network services (LAN wired/wireless, WAN, SD-WAN, network security, and shared infrastructure) from provisioning to decommissioning at airports and gateways.
  • Lead implementation and deployment of airport network and security infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, firewalls, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  • Provide expert-level support for complex network and security incidents when required.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including GEOs, to validate design documents, implement, and optimize network services aligned with business and customer needs.
  • Oversee service provisioning to ensure timely, accurate delivery and adherence to quality and operational standards.
  • Non-intrusive resiliency testing, timely audit security and configuration parameters aligned with engineering guidelines, drive proactive continuous service improvements.
  • Manage changes and enhancements to network and security services, mitigating risks and minimizing operational disruption.
  • Drive migration management activities, including root cause analysis and service improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies, provide guidance and training to operational teams, and support 24/7 operations and on-call activities as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
  • Mandatory Security Associate–level certification and Professional-level SD-WAN certification.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • 8–10 years of proven experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of network services, including provisioning, monitoring, optimization, and decommissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of network service lifecycle management, service models, SLAs, and network management tools.
  • Hands-on experience in network service design, implementation, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes within network operations.
  • Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF; EIGRP and RIP as a plus).
  • Strong working knowledge of network and security technologies, including VTP, STP/RSTP/PVST, HSRP, and firewalls (Cisco ASA, Palo Alto).
  • Experience with Cisco and Juniper routers and switches, data center technologies (Cisco Nexus, ACI), and SD-WAN solutions (Versa preferred), with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally and support operational teams.

What We Offer

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

title: AI Conversational Designer (Bangkok-Based, Relocation Provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Role

We’re looking for an AI Conversational Designer to shape the behavior, flow, and quality of Agoda’s Chatbot assistant. This role owns how our Chatbot operates in multi-turn conversations: how they gather and use context, structure dialog, manage pacing and depth, and maintain a consistent voice across end-to-end journeys. It sits at the intersection of conversation design, UX, and content strategy, with a strong focus on AI-driven interactions. This is not a traditional content writing role. It’s a specialist position focused on designing scalable, high-quality conversational experiences for AI products.

What You’ll Do

Conversational experience:

  • Design and evolve conversational flows across user travel intents.
  • Define how the assistant gathers context through dialog, including sequencing, branching, and trade-offs.
  • Establish principles for conversational depth, pacing, and progression.
  • Own conversational experimentation, including defining hypotheses, running tests, and iterating based on user behavior and outcomes.

Tone and behavior:

  • Define and maintain the assistant’s tone of voice and behavioral principles in line with Agoda’s brand.
  • Ensure conversational consistency as new features, journeys, and surfaces are added.

AI and experimentation:

  • Guide LLM behavior through conversational patterns, examples, guardrails, and prompt optimization.
  • Design and run conversational experiments, including A/B testing, to validate approaches and improve outcomes.
  • Use data and qualitative feedback to iterate on conversational quality and effectiveness.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designs, Content teams, Branding, and Engineering to align conversational intent with technical capabilities.
  • Act as a specialist partner, helping teams reason through conversational UX decisions rather than just producing outputs.

Enablement:

  • Create lightweight artifacts such as conversation flows, pattern libraries, and example dialogs.
  • Enable other designers to apply conversational patterns without creating long-term dependency.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • Experience in conversation design, or interaction design
  • Experience in prompt engineering and optimization
  • Demonstrated ability to design multi-turn, goal-oriented conversational experiences
  • Strong systems thinking and comfort working with ambiguity
  • Experience collaborating with UX designers, product managers and engineers
  • Experience working on chatbots, assistants, or AI-driven products

Nice to have:

  • Experience defining tone of voice or behavioral principles at scale
  • Background in service design or journey design

Why join us

  • Work on a high-impact product used by travelers globally
  • Shape conversational behavior at a platform level, not just feature by feature
  • Collaborate with experienced Product, Design, and Engineering teams
  • Opportunity to influence how conversational UX is practiced and scaled at Agoda

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Conduct NIH-funded research on RNA-based gene regulation in Staphylococcus aureus, a gram-positive bacterial pathogen prone to cause multi-drug-resistant bloodstream infections. The specific focus will be on small proteins, small RNAs, and tRNA modifications. The postdoctoral research fellow will lead experiments investigating RNA–RNA and RNA–protein interactions in bacterial stress adaptation and virulence.

Supervisory Authority

Dr. Karl M. Thompson, Ph.D. – Associate Professor and University Biosafety Officer

Nature And Scope

This is a lab-based research position in molecular microbiology. The Fellow will:

  • Perform functional studies of small protein and RNA function and interactions using and combination of molecular genetics (mutants, over-expression, gene-fusions, two-hybrid constructs); biochemical and biophysical tools (e.g., AUC, MST, SEC-MALS).
  • Conduct RNA stability assays, RIP-seq, and bacterial genetics.
  • Collaborate on in vivo studies and murine infection models.
  • Contribute to mentoring, manuscript writing, and data presentation.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Design and execute experiments on RNA regulators and stress-response pathways.
  • Analyze and interpret data from RNA-protein and RNA-RNA interaction assays.
  • Generate and characterize mutant bacterial strains.
  • Maintain detailed lab records and uphold research rigor.
  • Support manuscript and grant preparation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong background in molecular microbiology and RNA biology.
  • Experience with RNA-binding assays, RIP/qPCR/seq, and transcript stability analysis.
  • Familiarity with protein–RNA interaction techniques and bacterial genetics.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or related field.
  • Track record in RNA biology or microbial gene regulation.
  • Hands-on experience with relevant molecular techniques.
  • Prior S. aureus or Gram-positive pathogen work preferred

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More tasks and responsibilities

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
  • Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

Additional information

Do you have questions regarding the role? Please contact Vinicius Lima, Operations Superintendent at

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English through our recruitment portal. Unfortunately we do not consider CVs sent via email.

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

title: Research Assistant-1
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Under the supervision of the Principal Investigator and site Project Manager, the Research Assistant will conduct interviews and assessments and administer questionnaires; conducting outreach, education, and engagement activities to identify and recruit study participants; collect, gather, or organize data from different sources (including, for example, electronic medical records or public or other data sources); maintain research databases and files; perform or assist in literature searches; perform general administrative tasks; participate with the research team in conducting basic data analyses and preparing reports, including progress reports and provide recovery guiding. This specific position will involve supporting clinical trials and clinical demonstration projects, other clinical research and program development activities, and will work closely with other team members including addiction medicine specialists who will prescribe medications to treat opioid use disorder in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences.

Supervisory Authority

No direct reports but, may provide technical supervision to junior staff or students.

Nature And Scope

Interact with patients, families, University and Hospital staff, community-based organizations and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Recruits participants into research studies; assesses potential participants for eligibility; enrolls study participants, including explaining research procedures & protocols and obtaining informed consent of subjects and/or their families.
  • Responsible for a) recruiting study participants; b) tracking and maintaining contact with study participants after enrollment; and c) maintaining high rates of retention in research follow-up assessments.
  • Schedules appointments of study participants; contacts participants to remind them about appointments.
  • Participates in and successfully completes clinical research and IRB training requirements.
  • Assist in the submission of IRB applications.
  • Administers questionnaires, conducts interviews and assessments following established protocols, and assists study participants in navigating through questionnaires.
  • Performs a variety of data management procedures (e.g., data entry, producing basic reports, data cleaning, database maintenance).
  • Use active learning approaches to engage participants in learning about opioid use disorder (OUD), Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) with buprenorphine, the role of MOUD in treatment and recovery, and the role of behavioral change in recovery.
  • Codes qualitative interviews using codebooks and NVIVO database. Utilizes databases (e.g., Excel) to track research activities and to record data.
  • Aids in the development of reports, grants, presentations, and data analysis. Assists with manuscript and grant preparation and research.
  • Engages in outreach, education, and participant recruitment activities at community and social service agencies, such as food distribution sites, needle and syringe exchange programs, health clinics, hospital emergency departments, and health fairs or other community events.
  • Maintains logs of and documents outreach, engagement, recruitment, and follow-up activities.
  • Monitor with the participant the participant’s progress implementing the plans and achieving the objectives and work with the participant to revise the plans as needed to increase success in accomplishing the objectives.
  • Attends all required training and meetings of the research team, as instructed by Principal Investigator or Project Manager.
  • Provide manual-guided individual counseling (Recovery Guiding) to participants.
  • Participate in and successfully complete initial training and certification, including workshops and provision of Recovery Guiding under close supervision.
  • Meets regularly with study team to track and manage community outreach, engagement, recruitment, and follow-up activities and to address recruitment and data retention issues.
  • May be assigned to attend local or national meetings and conferences to discuss peer outreach activities recovery guiding and disseminate research results.
  • Understands and adheres to confidentiality and privacy protections for persons with opioid or other substance use and for study participants and maintains appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Maintains established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance programs, safety, environmental and infection control standards. Participates in staff meetings/initiatives including appropriate quality improvement and education activities, or if unable to attend non-mandatory activities, accepts responsibility to review meeting minutes and becomes knowledgeable of issues discussed.
  • Conforms to College of Medicine and hospital standards of performance and conduct, including those pertaining to patient rights, so that the best possible service and patient care may be provided.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Professional demeanor, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Must have the ability to take initiative and handle multiple priorities and tasks. Ability to communicate effectively (listen and build trust) and interact with respect and nonjudgmentally with people of different genders, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, ethnic, language and cultural backgrounds.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multi-disciplinary team to manage community engagement recruitment and other project tasks.
  • Comfortable about and capable of going to, working in, and engaging and recruiting for participation in the study people with untreated opioid use disorder in a broad variety of community settings and locations, including high drug use areas.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (i.e., MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook) and web browsers. Experience with database management tools and statistical software (e.g., NVIVO, SPSS, SAS) is a plus.
  • Coursework in data collection and research methodology.
  • Must successfully complete training in human participant research certification.

Minimum Requirements

A bachelor’s or master’s degree is preferred, along with 1–3 years of research experience. Experience conducting research in behavioral health (addiction or mental health), public health, and/or clinical study settings is preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

title: Technical Account Engineering / Customer Solutions (Renewable Energy)
description:
Overview

Our client is a leading international industrial group specialized in biogas and biomethane valorization solutions. With one of the largest installed bases of operational units worldwide, the company designs, manufactures, and deploys modular, containerized, and industrialized systems recognized for their high performance, reliability, and technological maturity. Its solutions serve industrial agribusiness groups, energy players, and environmental operators across global markets.

As part of its long-term development strategy in Brazil, the company is strengthening its local organization and is looking for a Technical Account Engineer to support project execution and client management, while contributing to the structuring and growth of its Brazilian operations.

The position is remote, based in Brazil (Curitiba, São Paulo State or Rio de Janeiro) , with frequent travel across the country and occasional international trips.

Missions

Reporting to the International Sales Manager (LATAM) and working closely with European engineering teams, you will support the execution of biogas and biomethane projects in Brazil, acting as the local technical and operational reference for clients.

  • You will manage and follow up projects from a technical standpoint, coordinating interfaces between headquarters engineering teams, local Brazilian subcontractors, and industrial end customers to ensure smooth project execution.
  • You will oversee the implementation of modular and containerized biogas upgrading systems (drying, filtration, compression, integrated units), supporting technical clarification phases and contributing to successful delivery.
  • You will act as the Responsible Engineer (Engenheiro Responsável) for the company in Brazil, ensuring compliance with CREA requirements and local engineering regulations, and interfacing with local authorities when required.
  • You will represent the company in technical meetings, site visits, and project reviews, building trusted relationships with industrial stakeholders and providing structured reporting and feedback to international headquarters.
  • While not responsible for active prospecting, you will demonstrate strong client orientation and commercial awareness , contributing to long-term customer satisfaction and repeat business.

Profile

You hold a Brazilian engineering degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical / Process, Energy, Environmental Engineering, among others) and have initial professional experience (2 to 4 years) in an industrial, infrastructure, or energy-related environment.

  • You are comfortable operating in industrial project settings , managing technical interfaces between multiple stakeholders, and adapting to both international standards and local constraints.
  • Exposure to renewable energy, biogas, biomethane, energy infrastructure, or complex industrial systems is a strong advantage, but motivated profiles from adjacent industries are also considered.
  • You are autonomous, adaptable, and comfortable representing an international group locally in a growing and partially structured organization.
  • You have strong communication skills, are client-oriented, and able to lead technical discussions with demanding industrial stakeholders.
  • You speak Portuguese natively and have an advanced level of English for technical and professional communication. French is a plus and strongly recommended.
  • You are based in Brazil and available to travel frequently within the country and internationally for training.

Our client is a reference player in renewable gas solutions , operating at the forefront of the energy transition. Brazil represents one of the most strategic markets for biogas and biomethane development worldwide.

This position offers high responsibility, visibility, and long-term evolution opportunities , with the potential to grow toward project leadership, technical management, and broader LATAM responsibilities as the organization expands.

If you are motivated by industrial challenges, autonomy, and client-facing technical roles in an international environment , this opportunity provides both impact and strong career progression.

title: Senior R&D Manager
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

Ideal role for an experienced & ambitious scientist within agronomy. As our Senior Research and Development (R&D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as helping to address fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members, and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the VP of Science and Research, you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will lead and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead and our Agronomic R&D Lead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our agronomy R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planning our agronomy R+D programme, such as the design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting, and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work with flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • You are an experienced senior scientist with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Plant Science, Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry or related fields
  • You have, ideally, 5+ years of experience in senior research or research related roles
  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, with a focus on agronomy or a related field
  • You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals
  • You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g., from industry, government and academia.
  • You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials
  • You are fluent in Portuguese
  • You have advanced English language skills
  • You are based in Brazil (ideally Piracicaba or Sao Paulo region)
